title: AppTest doesn't work with relative filenames in st.sidebar.page_link()
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

AppTest doesn't work with relative filenames in st.sidebar.page_link()

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
-- 1_Home.py

import streamlit as st

st.sidebar.page_link("pages/10_MyPage.py")
st.text_input("test")

-- pages/10_MyPage.py
import streamlit as st

st.text("Some text")

-- test/test.py
import os
from streamlit.testing.v1 import AppTest

def test_home():
    # Works
    at = AppTest.from_file(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '../1_Home.py'))).run()
    # Fails
    at = AppTest.from_file("../1_Home.py").run()
    assert not at.exception
```


### Steps To Reproduce

1. `python -m pytest test/test.py`

### Expected Behavior

App Test runs successfully

### Current Behavior

Test fails

```
2024-02-14 11:43:51.915 Uncaught app exception
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/[HOME]/anaconda3/lib/python3.11/site-packages/streamlit/runtime/scriptrunner/script_runner.py", line 535, in _run_script
    exec(code, module.__dict__)
  File "/[HOME]/junk/st_issue/1_Home.py", line 3, in <module>
    st.sidebar.page_link("pages/10_MyPage.py")
  File "/[HOME]/anaconda3/lib/python3.11/site-packages/streamlit/runtime/metrics_util.py", line 397, in wrapped_func
    result = non_optional_func(*args, **kwargs)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/[HOME]/anaconda3/lib/python3.11/site-packages/streamlit/elements/widgets/button.py", line 526, in page_link
    return self._page_link(
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/[HOME]/anaconda3/lib/python3.11/site-packages/streamlit/elements/widgets/button.py", line 691, in _page_link
    raise StreamlitAPIException(
streamlit.errors.StreamlitAPIException: Could not find page: 'pages/10_MyPage.py'. Must be the file path relative to the main script, from the directory: ...
```

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.31.0
- Python version: 3.11.4
- Operating System: macOS Sonoma 14.1.1
- Browser: Not a browser issue


### Additional Information

_No response_

Thank you for the issue! [USER] is working on our App Testing Framework and will take this into account as we improve this scenario.

`st.page_link` also throw the same error in the page smoke test.

```
Could not find page: `pages/x.py`. Must be the file path relative to the main script, from the directory: `pages`. Only the main app file and files in the `pages/` directory are supported.
```

I started looking into this, assuming it was going to be an issue with the hacky way I turn strings into relative paths, but I'm having trouble reproducing the error, as the "Fails" version works for me. The most suspect difference between my attempt and what you report is that I tested it on linux. I will see if I can reproduce it on macOS directly.

It apparently works for me on `1.31.1`, but fails with the expected error on `1.31.0`. I know we had several bug fixes for `page_link` in the patch, so it seems like this issue was fixed incidentally. I'm going to assume this is resolved, but please reopen if you are still having this issue on `1.31.1` or later.

The error still occur on `1.31.1`. For me the error happen when running the GitHub action workflow.
Link to the corresponding failed GitHub Action run for reference:
https://github.com/s4021245/streamlit-gh-action-test/actions/runs/8013304706/job/21890126718

I was able to investigate this using your `streamlit-gh-action-test` repo and a Streamlit wheel with more detailed error messages. I believe the problem during the smoke test is because it tries to run each page independently as an app test. If you run `streamlit run pages/page_1.py` in that repo the same error will occur, because it sees `pages` as the main directory.

This doesn't seem like a bug with `AppTest` exactly, but we could potentially support switching pages in AppTest better so the smoke test could use that instead of the current approach.

Hi, everyone! 

I'm having the same issue here, but with Streamlit version 1.33.0.

Is there already a solution?

Thanks!

Re-verified against current `develop` at `0aba4dab0b` using the original directory layout and the relative `AppTest.from_file("../1_Home.py")` call. The test now passes without an AppTest exception, including `st.sidebar.page_link("pages/10_MyPage.py")`.

The separate scenario discussed later in this thread—executing a file under `pages/` directly as its own AppTest—changes which file is treated as the main script. That scenario is supported by starting AppTest from the main script and using `AppTest.switch_page()`, and overlaps #8429.
